priorCycle.remainsPinned: The GitHub blob for claude-code-changelog-main stays pinned to commit db93774d73e8fdbaf315a6f4c175ae99ad3d515a (sha256 7abf62a98e6739e0b51071c5e289b0a6baef4f3a2d08046a6df2b338b3d0d086) as the previous verified baseline; it is not rewritten by this cycle.

method: Read-only curl GET against the official Claude Code changelog page; no authentication, no private or session data sent. The GitHub-hosted raw and API endpoints were unreachable from this environment in this cycle and were not retried with any wider access.

outage.symptom: The environment resolved these hosts to non-public addresses, so the read-only fetch failed before any content was read.
outage.resolution: The served official changelog page (code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog.md) was reachable over curl and re-verified the same three lines at the same versions.
outage.previousBaseline: The pinned GitHub changelog at db93774 remains the verified baseline for the previous cycle and is preserved as carried-over evidence.

licenseCheck.interpretation: GitHub reports no detectable license file for the upstream repository as of 2026-10-14. The baseline quotes only short official release and changelog sentences for factual tracking and copies no upstream code.

algorithmDisclosure.note: The official release note and changelog describe the feature and two follow-up changes but not how the side agent selects, gates, deduplicates, or formats notes. No reverse engineering is attempted.
